preconditions.text: A fee-on-transfer token is configured as the disputeToken.; A user calls disputeTree() sending disputeAmount tokens (e.g., 1000 tokens).; The fee-on-transfer token deducts a transfer fee on the deposit (e.g., 1% = 10 tokens).; No recovery path exists: recoverERC20() cannot help because resolveDispute() must succeed first, and depositing more tokens does not help since the FoT token takes fees on outgoing transfers; only contract upgrade/migration recovers.

This occurs because `disputeTree()` records the full `disputeAmount` but the contract receives fewer tokens due to the transfer fee, making it impossible to transfer back the recorded amount during resolution.
1. Governor sets `disputeToken` to a FoT token (PAXG, some USDT implementations, deflationary tokens)
When a user calls `disputeTree()` with a FoT token:
- User sends `disputeAmount` tokens (e.g., 1000 tokens)
3. User calls `disputeTree()` - deposits tokens in good faith
- FoT token deducts transfer fee (e.g., 1% = 10 tokens)
6. No Recovery Path:
- `recoverERC20()` cannot help because `resolveDispute()` needs to succeed first to clear `disputer`
- Even depositing more tokens doesn't help - the FoT token will take fees on the outgoing transfer too
- Contract upgrade/migration is the only recovery option
